question_text: Read the following text and fill in each gap with a
stimulus: suitable word based on the information of the text.15 = 5 Yoga can help a person to give the best of him/her in a situation of stress and anxiety. It is a kind of posture and breathing exercise. It is physical and mental practices or disciplines. It helps people achieve peace of body and mind, and manage stress and anxiety. Generally, yoga puts emphasis on behaviour, diet and meditation. But it can also be helpful if people are just looking for better stress management− and not an entire lifestyle change. It has health benefits like stress reduction, increased fitness, management of chronic health conditions, weight loss, etc. | 146 With its quiet, precise movements, yoga draws people's focus from chaos to calmness of mind. People can also gain fitness of health. It might also help with a variety of health condition like cancer, depression, insomnia, heart diseases, etc. [Unit-2; Lesson-1] Yoga is a relaxation technique in which a (a) ⎯ of breathing, exercising and meditation prevails in the right portion. It helps to increase the (b) ⎯ of the body as well as to bring a complete (c) ⎯ between mind and body. In the case of stress reduction, yoga trainers (d) ⎯ on meditation. To achieve physical and emotional harmony, therefore, we cannot ignore the (e) ⎯ benefits of yoga. Read the passage and answer the questions 4 and 5. William Blake poet and artist was born in London in 1757. During his early years he showed himself a dreamer and visionary. Beyond leaning how to read and write, he received no education, but began to copy prints and write verses at the age of ten. At the age of fourteen he was apprenticed to an engraver. He married Catherine Boucher at the age of twenty five and shortly afterwards, set up a print shop. A patron of him provided him a cottage on the Sussex coast, he spent all his life in London. 'The poet Sketches' a collection of his early poems, was published in 1783. With the help of his wife he published "Songs of Innocence" in 1789. 'Songs of experience' was published five years after. His only book in prose named 'The Marriage of Heaven and Hell' was published in 1790. His other books Milton was written 1804-8 and 1804-20. He died at his sixty ninth years.
